title: Putu and Gutu
summary: Little Putu the fish is quietly eating seaweed in the pond, until big Gutu comes to chase him. How will Putu get away?
pages: Putu swims in the pond. He eats seaweed.
Putu swims this way. Putu swims that way. Gutu chases him.
Putu jumps up. Gutu jumps too.
Gutu dives too! Gutu swims after Putu.
